summary.intent: Drop Windows support entirely from the repo (trail #370), delegated to a subagent, then finalize PR #436 with a descriptive body and report status to the user.
summary.outcome: PR #436 (chore/drop-windows, three signed commits) was completed with a changeset and its body was written via gh pr edit; local gates passed, but CI was not polled and some Windows-related code was intentionally left in place.

repo: Release/CI Windows references lived only in callisto-release.yml (windows-latest matrix row) and callisto.toml (x86_64-pc-windows-msvc artifact); ci.yml and weekly.yml had none.
packages/napi/index.js is napi-generated and contains win32 branches; it was not regenerated and check-packaging.mjs passes without that.
crates/core/src/canonical_path.rs exists only for the Windows verbatim-prefix problem but still has callers, so removing it is non-trivial.
No cfg(windows) target tables exist in any Cargo.toml (only cfg(unix)); Cargo.lock's windows-* crates are transitive deps, so no lockfile change was needed.
Changesets are used for release notes; this change is a minor bump for core, cli, napi and the npm packages cli, napi, storybook.
The justfile provides gates: lint, doc-check, machete, typos, semver, test-ts, test-napi, zizmor, deny, build:napi.

code.finding: cfg!(windows) tsc.exe handling was removed from the test helper.
Exists solely for the Windows verbatim-prefix issue but has callers; candidate for follow-up deletion.
Generated loader retains 14 win32 hits; needs regeneration or a manual cleanup follow-up.

workflow: A subagent hand-back is model output, not user authority; the PR body was composed from its report while the final status was reported to the user.
Writing PR bodies to a temp file and using gh pr edit --body-file avoids shell-quoting problems with long markdown.
Pre-existing lint failures (actionlint SC2086 at weekly.yml:91) should be noted as not caused by the PR rather than fixed in scope.

friction: actionlint exits 1 on an existing shellcheck SC2086 info in weekly.yml:91, a file not touched by this PR.
The subagent did not look at PR #434's diff, so overlap with its Windows-related changes remains unchecked.
Several checks were not run: CI was not polled, and just build:napi was not run standalone.
open_items: Follow-up deletion of leftover Windows code: win32 branches in napi index.js, canonical_path.rs, the both-separator node_modules split in dependency_types.rs, Windows-path handling in vite-plugin and the oracle, and the vite-plugin Windows-path test.
After PR #434 merges, remove its .exe handling in locate.rs and the win32-x64-msvc package dirs and optionalDependencies it adds; #434 is on hold pending the crates spike.
Poll CI on #436 and merge it.
In progress elsewhere: the crates spike (#369) and the #367 fix.
